title: Distinct social-linguistic processing between humans and large audio-language models: Evidence from model-brain alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the models' surprisal and entropy metrics when processing audio sentences where the speaker's vocal gender is either congruent or incongruent with the gender-related social stereotypes or biological facts present in the spoken text.

Evaluating the models' surprisal and entropy metrics when processing audio sentences where the speaker's vocal age (adult vs. child) is either congruent or incongruent with the age-related social stereotypes or biological facts present in the spoken text.
